git_status: not a git repository; no git history/commits configured
scope: All top-level entries and recursive file inventory; data record integrity separately audited. Source AST inventory includes every active src/test module and historical notebook-checkpoint script.

source_catalogue.docstring: Read-only inventory of the separate, unused local PTB-XL waveform dataset.
Check that source JPEGs exactly match the retained original image archive.
Run one prespecified baseline. Test data are scored only after fitting/model selection.

Report one completed, verified PTB-XL image run from saved predictions only.

No model/checkpoint loading, image access, inference, fitting, threshold search,
or bootstrap resampling occurs here. Existing reporting outputs are protected
unless --overwrite explicitly authorizes replacing this command's own files.

Independently verify a completed PTB-XL run using saved artifacts only.

``verify(run_id)`` is read-only and raises on missing or inconsistent artifacts.
The explicit command-line entry point writes verification.json after success.
Checkpoint tensors are inspected, never instantiated as a model or evaluated.
Bootstrap point estimates and structural validity are checked; its 500
resamples are not repeated. Saved inference bookkeeping cannot prove the
absence of unrecorded work outside this experiment.

Immutable, lazy image inputs for the five-label PTB-XL experiment.

Only generated PNG pixels are model inputs. Twelve complete lead rows are
inverted to ink and reduced by 2x2 maximum pooling; this retains every source
pixel's opportunity to contribute, including calibration, but thickens strokes
and loses detail. This is image preprocessing, not waveform reconstruction.

Prepare deterministic PTB-XL rendering and classification metadata.

All source records are returned for rendering. Five diagnostic superclass
targets use all present diagnostic SCP keys, including confidence zero, as in
the distributed example. No-Mapped-class rows remain present but are ineligible
for classification. No labels or source metadata should be printed on images.

Interface: result = prepare_manifest(dataset_dir, audit_path). The result has
rows, summary, and expected_checksums attributes. This function is read-only.

Offline verification of the separate PTB-XL CNN + causal-TCN image run.

The read-only verify() function checks saved evidence; only the CLI writes a
new verification.json. It never trains, constructs a model, evaluates a
checkpoint, decodes image pixels, or repeats bootstrap resampling. Shared
stateless readers/metric checks are reused without changing the earlier
verifier or running its model-specific verification entry point.
Compare three saved image-model runs without fitting or new inference.

Read-only label readiness review of the frozen image cohort.

Writes aggregate group evidence and an unfilled development-only adjudication
queue. It never imports model outputs, changes labels, or rebuilds the split.
Uses only Python's standard library: python3 -m src.review_labels.
Execute one frozen image CNN-LSTM experiment; test inference follows selection.

Compare two completed, verified PTB-XL models using saved probabilities.

No image decoding, checkpoint loading, inference, fitting or threshold search
occurs. Paired patient-cluster resampling estimates test differences conditional
on the two fitted models. The previously inspected test cohort makes this an
exploratory comparison, not a fresh confirmatory model-selection experiment.
Reproducible ECG image baseline experiments.

Conservative image-similarity screening before model fitting; never deletes images.

Perceptual hashes screen candidate pairs. Extremely similar crop tensors are
grouped to avoid crossing split boundaries. This does not establish that every
remaining pair comes from a different patient or acquisition.
Generate and verify the full, separately versioned PTB-XL image cohort.

Report one completed, verified PTB-XL image run from saved predictions only.

No model/checkpoint loading, image access, inference, fitting, threshold search,
or bootstrap resampling occurs here. Existing reporting outputs are protected
unless --overwrite explicitly authorizes replacing this command's own files.

Review frozen baseline errors without training or model inference.

Case-level analysis is restricted to development partitions. Previously recorded
test confusion matrices are reproduced only as explicitly post-hoc aggregates.
Protect the original baselines while allowing new experiment-log rows.

Deterministic, calibrated clean pages from real PTB-XL waveforms.

No diagnoses, demographics or identifiers are accepted by the pixel renderer.
Every lead is plotted over the full source duration, with shared horizontal time.
Validate the frozen split and cache without fitting or scoring any model.
Illustrate one training-only crop candidate; never replaces an experiment input.
Run the prespecified five-label image experiment without changing prior runs.
Verify baseline preservation and completed technical reviews, without fitting models.
Compare already saved evidence; never rerun models or tune against test labels.
Audit originals, exclude exact copies, freeze one group-aware split, cache tiny inputs.
Run the prespecified five-label image experiment without changing prior runs.

CPU CNN+LSTM for twelve aligned rendered ECG lead images.

Datasets supply images already standardized with training-only statistics.
Five sigmoid targets overlap: probabilities must never be row-normalized.
Training accepts training and validation datasets only, with no test argument.

Small CNN+LSTM classifier of spatial columns in frozen ECG images.

The sequence axis follows image width. It is NOT calibrated time: the input
contains multiple ECG leads in a page layout and no waveform digitization.
LDA and CNN baselines; unconfirmed model names are not implemented.

Small, deterministic four-class ECG image CNN baseline.

The caller owns the audited, frozen split and image preprocessing. This module
accepts training and validation arrays only; test data cannot influence fitting
or checkpoint selection. Inputs are grayscale ink arrays (N, 1, 128, 256).

Controlled CNN plus causal feature-convolution head for ECG lead images.

Datasets supply images already standardized with training-only statistics.
Five sigmoid targets overlap: probabilities must never be row-normalized.
Training accepts training and validation datasets only, with no test argument.
The head is causal in its supplied horizontal feature sequence. The shared CNN
uses symmetric filters and spatial GroupNorm, and final mean pooling uses the
whole image; this is not an end-to-end causal waveform or streaming model.

Patient-cluster bootstrap uncertainty conditional on a frozen ECG model.

Every patient draw includes all of that patient's observed ECG records, with
full multiplicity when a patient is drawn repeatedly. No thresholds, calibration
parameters or models are fitted. The bootstrap seed does not change training RNGs.

Five-label ECG evaluation with one prespecified 0.5 decision threshold.

Sigmoid probabilities are independent across labels and need not sum to one.
Undefined ranking metrics remain null. No threshold fitting is performed.
Shared four-class metrics and saved prediction evidence.
Dataset validation and deterministic image preprocessing.

Audit printed ECG header IDs with macOS Vision; never infer patient identity.

Run with a Python environment containing PyObjC and Pillow. This helper hashes
source files, recognizes the fixed header region of one image per exact-byte
group, and records its OCR evidence. Printed IDs are unverified report/patient
identifiers: use them conservatively as grouping keys, not as proven patients.
No source files are changed. No manual corrections are performed.

Offline, exact-glyph header transcription for this fixed rendered image cohort.

This is a narrowly scoped typography lookup, not a general OCR system. Manually
read reference headers cover digits 0..9. Unknown/non-exact glyphs are rejected.
Printed IDs remain unverified report identifiers, not established patient IDs.
Isolated PTB-XL orchestration tests: no real images, training, or logs.
Small synthetic tests only; no research train/validation/test records.
Synthetic saved-artifact tests; no real cohort or model inference.
Isolated PTB-XL orchestration tests: no real images, training, or logs.
Synthetic smoke checks; no research test data are used here.
Synthetic runner and append-only preservation checks; never touch project evidence.
Isolated saved-artifact report tests; no ECG files or model inference.
Synthetic physical-geometry and image-integrity tests; no dataset rendering.
Synthetic-only integrity and geometry checks; never prepare the real cache.
Temporary-only generator checks: provenance, safe resume and row preservation.
Hand-calculated multilabel metrics and undefined-class/output integrity checks.
Synthetic patient multiplicity, percentile and deterministic bootstrap checks.
Focused synthetic checks; no PTB-XL images, source signals or splits read.
Synthetic paired comparisons; no real ECG images or predictions are read.
Synthetic-only controls for the image CNN/causal feature-convolution model.
Small synthetic checks of PTB labels, patient isolation and source binding.
Synthetic checks for split isolation, frozen evidence, PCA fitting, and metrics.
Synthetic saved-artifact checks; never load or infer on the real cohort.
